name: Docs gap radar — turn unanswered questions into a content backlog

parameters.text:
These are questions people asked on a product's community forum this week.

{{ $json.digest }}

Group them into themes. For each theme decide whether it looks like a
DOCUMENTATION GAP (the docs do not cover it, or cover it badly) or ordinary
SUPPORT (a one-off mistake, an environment problem, a bug).

Rules:
1. Quote real titles as evidence. Do not paraphrase them and do not invent any.
   Every title you list must appear verbatim in the input above.
2. A single question is not a theme. Require at least two.
3. If you are unsure whether something is a docs gap, say support. Over-reporting
   gaps wastes a writer's week.

Return JSON only:
{"themes": [{"theme": "...", "is_docs_gap": true|false, "evidence_titles": ["..."], "suggested_article": "..."}]}

parameters.formDescription: Approve the themes worth turning into articles.
